description: The ONLY tool that collects contact details, and the end of the 10-minute promise. Also pass every onboarding answer you gathered (heard_from, own_choice, payer, kpis, cadence_preference, session_language, nda_needed, homework_time_ok, in_person_wish, linkedin_url, li_post_consent, li_recommendation); all optional, never invented: emails the visitor a formal itemized offer with a claim code, notifies Marian, and files the inquiry. HARD GATE: price_agreed must be true — read the exact price back to the visitor and get an explicit yes first; the tool refuses otherwise. Ask for name and email only at this step, never earlier. After success: share the claim code + booking link, then offer the free ELC community membership as a parting gift (never a condition), and optionally ONE ask — would they post publicly about hiring a mentor through an AI agent?

cadence_preference.description: Preference only; the final cadence is settled after session 1 One of: weekly, biweekly, monthly, undecided.

context.description: Optional. A short description of your goal and why you are calling this tool. Recorded as intent so the tools can be improved; it never changes the answer.

email.description: Required. Email the offer goes to

free_sessions_requested.description: Company deals only: the free-sessions proposal from the catalog progression (2, 4 or 8)

heard_from.description: How they found Marian, in their words (referral name, LinkedIn, Google, ChatGPT, ELC…)

homework_time_ok.description: Can they give about an hour a week between sessions

in_person_wish.description: Would they like to meet Marian in person (Prague)

kpis.description: Up to two measurable KPIs in their words, scored in session 1 and the last session

li_post_consent.description: May Marian post on LinkedIn that they work together (never the content) One of: yes, later, no.

li_recommendation.description: Would they write Marian a LinkedIn recommendation once happy One of: yes, later, no.

nda_needed.description: One of: no, their-template, marian-template, unsure.

offer_id.description: Required. One of: single-session, first-quarter, monthly, mentor-in-residence, mentor-in-residence-2day.

own_choice.description: Mentee's own decision, sent by the company, or both One of: own, sent, both.

payer.description: Who pays. Company: the purchase order comes AFTER session 1, never before booking One of: self, company, undecided.

price_agreed.description: Required. True ONLY after the visitor explicitly agreed to the exact price from compose_mentoring_brief

start_date.description: Optional preferred start date — adds the dated program skeleton to the offer email

visibility.description: Visibility answer id (yes-individual | yes-company | maybe-later | private)

name: send_mentoring_offer
title: Send the formal itemized offer (applies the AI-channel discount)
